trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: The proof ends on the verification table, not on a restatement.
trap-thesis-restatement.notes: SEPARATE (non-trap) MATH finding - a WRONG displayed formula in the n = 3 verification, with a full recomputation. The block displays Im Li_3(zeta_K) = (n-1)(n-2) pi^3 / (3 n^3) '(see Theorem A)'. In THIS block n is the DEPTH and is fixed at 3, so the right-hand side is the K-independent constant 2 pi^3/81 = 0.765587078526. The true values are K-dependent: computed at 40 dps, Im Li_3(zeta_K) = 0.765587078526 (K=3), 0.968946146259 (K=4), 0.992200853770 (K=5), 0.956983848157 (K=6), 0.903973081058 (K=7) - so the stated formula is 21.0% low at K=4 and 22.8% low at K=5, and is right ONLY at K=3, which is why the error survives inspection. Deriving from the block's own Step 3: Im Li_3(zeta_K) = -(2 pi i)^3/(2 i . 3!) B_3(1/K) = (2/3) pi^3 B_3(1/K), and B_3(1/K) = (K-1)(K-2)/(2K^3), giving (K-1)(K-2) pi^3/(3 K^3) - verified to 12 digits for K = 3..7. ROOT CAUSE: the formula was imported verbatim from prop:cyclotomic-trilog-imaginary-closed-form, where n IS the root-of-unity index; here n is the depth. This is the AGENTS.md render-QA symbol-collision rule ('no symbol is silently reused for two meanings'). FIX: write (K-1)(K-2) pi^3 / (3 K^3). Also '(see Theorem A)' does not resolve to any label in this corpus's scheme (the same dangling 'Theorem A' appears twice in cyclotomic-depth3-dimension-synthesis-proof.md); it should cite prop:cyclotomic-trilog-imaginary-closed-form. VERIFIED CORRECT by the same recomputation: Step 1 (Jonquiere inversion), Step 2 (log(-zeta_K) = i pi (2-K)/K and the Bernoulli argument collapsing to 1/K), Step 3 (both parity branches), the n=2 check (-pi^2/12 = Re Li_2(-1)), the n=4 form -pi^4/3 B_4(1/K), and the n=5 form -2 pi^5/15 B_5(1/K) - the last two match mpmath at 12 digits for K = 3, 5, 7. Minor: the verification grid K in {3,4,5,6,7} excludes K = 2, the very case the n=2 hand-check uses.
